title: Senior AI Automation Engineer
description: ‎York Towers is the development arm of the York Holding Group. Through continuous research and the ability to predict emerging trends, the company keeps an edge over the market. Playing a leading role in driving the successful development and diversification of one of the most vital economic sectors, York Towers is committed to creating residential products across the country that provide residents with distinctive, universal, multicultural, and enriching lifestyles. York Towers is the exclusive developer of luxury real estate worldwide. The company aims to become a leading real estate player through an efficient business model and advanced technologies used for designing and construction. Since its establishment in 2016, York Towers has delivered 20 real estate properties and runs six dynamic projects. York Towers operates eight offices in five countries across three continents. ‎About the RoleDwelleo is looking for an Senior AI Automation Specialist / AI Agent Workflow Architect to join our team improve efficiency, reduce manual work, enhance lead management, support sales operations, and create measurable business impact.The successful candidate will work across business, product, sales, lead scoring, lead routing, follow-up journeys, sales notifications, and customer engagement processes.•⁠ ⁠Integrate AI tools with systems such as Odoo CRM, WhatsApp, email, website forms, APIs, human-in-the-loop review points.•⁠ ⁠Develop automated reports and dashboards from CRM, marketing, and sales data.•⁠ ⁠Identify manual processes across departments and convert them into scalable automation workflows.•⁠ ⁠Test, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve automation performance.•⁠ ⁠Work closely with management to ensure all automation initiatives are aligned with business priorities and measurable outcomes.Expected Success OutcomesThe candidate should be able to deliver practical automations such as:•⁠ ⁠A new website lead is automatically captured, scored, added to CRM, assigned to the right sales person, and followed up through WhatsApp or email.•⁠ ⁠High-priority leads are identified and escalated automatically to the sales team.•⁠ ⁠Weekly management reports are generated automatically from CRM, marketing, and sales data.•⁠ ⁠Customer follow-up journeys are automated from first inquiry to meeting booking and sales handover.•⁠ ⁠Multiple AI agents coordinate together to complete tasks such as content creation, quality review, CRM updates, notifications, and reporting.Required Skills and Experience•⁠ ⁠Proven experience in AI automation, workflow automation, or business process automation.•⁠ ⁠Strong knowledge of automation platforms such as Make, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools.•⁠ ⁠Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI agent platforms.•⁠ ⁠Good understanding of CRM automation; experience with Odoo is a strong advantage.•⁠ ⁠Experience with APIs, webhooks, forms, WhatsApp automation, email automation, and dashboards.•⁠ ⁠Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical workflows.•⁠ ⁠Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.•⁠ ⁠Ability to test, document, monitor, and improve workflows after deployment.•⁠ ⁠Good communication skills and ability to work with non-technical business teams.Preferred Experience•⁠ ⁠Experience in PropTech, real estate, marketplace platforms, sales operations, or lead-generation businesses.•⁠ ⁠Experience building multi-agent AI workflows.•⁠ ⁠Experience with CRM data, marketing attribution, customer journeys, and sales pipeline automation.•⁠ ⁠Basic understanding of analytics tools, reporting dashboards, and performance metrics.Candidate ProfileWe are looking for someone who is practical, execution-driven, business-minded, and highly interested in applying AI to real company operations.
